required_adapters.note: A provider-neutral verifier now checks governed Aave V3 collateral and variable-debt positions, MPT account/storage proofs, reserve indexes, owner authorization, contract code hashes, Chainlink/capped-stable prices and freshness, conservative rounding, liabilities, and guest dispatch. It reproduces the historical A666 collateral and debt values. Public collection, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral successor verifier now checks an exact governed multichain native/ERC-20 position set, quorum-certified state roots and timestamps, account/storage MPT proofs, code hashes, owner authorization, decimals, omissions, duplicates, checked bounds, and guest dispatch. It reconstructs every native and ERC-20 proof in the historical A666 artifact. Prices remain a separate disclosed valuation trust dimension. Public collection, the governed A666 policy fixture, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral verifier now checks the HyperEVM reader receipt, BFT-certified header, owner authorization, positions, holds, values, liabilities, bounds, and guest dispatch, with historical receipt reconstruction. Public collection, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral verifier now checks certified-head, outcome, block, reader, pool, implicit-account ownership, quantity, bounds, and guest dispatch, with historical Merkle reconstruction. Valuation remains separately attested by design. Public collection, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.
Public code does not yet verify the governed Solana stake-account set, ownership, activation state, duplication constraints, freshness, and valuation.
Public code does not yet verify Monero reserve proofs, ownership challenges, replay/freshness, zero and nonzero balances, and separate XMR/USD valuation evidence.
